hypothesis: Given the same current H3 observation and proprioception, the correct 32-step action chunk predicts the H3 observation representation at start+32 better than either deranged or zero actions.
single_variable: Consequence target changes from future proprio to a fixed 256D random projection of mean-pooled future H3 layer49 features; the three-arm intervention, rows, seed and thresholds remain fixed.
parent_baseline: Future-proprio F1 passed at s100 and s500; this child has its own co-trained action-independent baseline and does not inherit effectiveness from the proprio target.

architecture.paper: Clean action conditions future image/state/value under a causal mask.
architecture.upstream_code: Future image latents are produced after clean action tokens.
architecture.local: Detached action plus current frozen H3/state predicts a fixed projection of future frozen H3.
architecture.rationale: H3 representation replaces RGB VAE latent to match the frozen INT8 carrier.

data.paper: Future observation follows the action segment.
data.upstream_code: Dataset emits a future image record.
data.local: Exact source-manifest row at the same episode and start+32; missing rows and changed context are rejected.
data.rationale: Dense stride permits an auditable future observation join.

action.local: Correct, deranged or zero normalized 32x7 action.
action.rationale: Same no-self-map control as F1 proprio.

objective.local: MSE on a non-trainable seeded 256D projection of frozen H3 layer49 mean features.
objective.rationale: The projection is saved in the checkpoint and cannot collapse to improve the metric.

optimization.local: 100 steps, batch16, 1600 samples from a fixed 1024-row subset.
optimization.rationale: This only gates whether action-conditioned future visual signal exists.

evaluation.local: 256 episode-disjoint rows; correct vs independent, shuffled-trained and shuffled-at-eval with three 1% gates.

evidence: Future target is absent from forward; fixed projection is a persistent non-trainable buffer.
Exact start+32 join and episode-disjoint split tests pass.
Same horizon32 unpadded intervention as F1 proprio.
Future features and projection target are detached.
Three arms share initialization, rows and optimizer hyperparameters.
Predeclared paired thresholds and deterministic selection.
Unit test proves upstream action generator receives no gradient while consequence action encoder does.
F1 proprio s500 mechanism pass; this run also contains an independent co-trained baseline.
Not applicable to representation-only consequence expert.

decision.rationale: The state consequence parent repeated successfully and the future-H3 implementation passes temporal-join, no-leak, finite-gradient and restore tests. Only one real s100 mechanism canary is authorized.
